full_prompt_en: A square cinematic interior image shows a powerful studio lamp casting visible beams across a dim grand hall. The room extends far back through high arches and deep green-black shadow. Along both side walls, small amber wall sconces recede in a loose rhythm, their warm glow too weak to reveal the entire architecture. On the left, a dark lighting fixture stands on a tripod near the wall. Slightly farther inward, a brilliant rectangular lamp faces across the room from left to right. Its cool white light cuts through suspended haze as several broad, slanting shafts, expanding toward the lower-right floor. A dark upholstered chair sits in the near left foreground, its back and arms held mostly in silhouette. Another smaller chair stands in the middle distance, partly swallowed by the light and fog. The wide floor is glossy or polished, catching elongated pale stripes from the lamp and a few tiny amber reflections from the sconces. The ceiling remains largely invisible, with only faint curved architectural lines emerging above the beams. At the right, tall arched recesses and columns are suggested by narrow outlines and local warm lights. The contrast is extreme: most of the hall stays charcoal and deep olive, while the cool beam makes a bright geometric corridor through the center. Light visibly comes from the practical lamp on the left, creating long directional highlights and shadows that run across the floor. Mild haze softens distant furniture but preserves the silhouette of the foreground chair. The overall composition is theatrical and spacious, allowing one artificial light source to reveal the depth of a room otherwise held in darkness.
full_prompt_zh: 这幅方形电影感室内影像呈现一盏强力影棚灯，将可见光束投过昏暗的大堂。房间沿高拱与深绿黑色阴影向后延伸。两侧墙上小小琥珀壁灯松散而有节奏地退向远处，暖光不足以揭开全部建筑。左侧一台深色灯具立在靠墙三脚架上。稍向内一盏明亮矩形灯从左朝右照射，冷白光切过悬浮雾气，形成几道宽阔斜束，并向右下方地板扩散。近处左前景一张深色软椅背和扶手大部分呈剪影。中景另有一张较小的椅子，部分被光与雾吞没。宽阔地板光亮或经抛光，接住灯投下的拉长浅色条纹和壁灯少量琥珀小倒影。天花板大体不可见，只有光束上方淡淡弯曲的建筑线条浮现。右侧高拱凹处和立柱由狭窄轮廓与局部暖灯暗示。反差极强：大堂多数区域留在炭色与深橄榄色里，冷光束则在中央切出明亮几何通道。光显然来自左侧实体灯具，在地板上制造长方向亮痕与阴影。轻雾柔化远处家具，却保留前景椅子的剪影。整体构图富戏剧性且宽敞，以唯一人工光源揭示原本被暗色包住的房间深度。
style_prompt_en: A cinematic low-key lighting style uses one intense off-center source to carve broad visible shafts through haze. Most of the frame remains charcoal, deep olive, or muted black, while cool white beams become geometric planes and fall as long stripes across a reflective lower surface. Small warm points sit far apart in the background, adding scale and depth without competing with the main light. Close objects read as dark silhouettes with occasional rim highlights; distant forms fade into atmospheric softness. Strong directional shadow and floor reflection agree with the visible source. High architectural or spatial repetition recedes toward a dim vanishing area, but detail stays selective. The composition is spacious, dramatic, and controlled, with illuminated air functioning as a material as much as the solid surfaces it strikes.
style_prompt_zh: 电影感低调布光以偏离中央的一盏强光在雾气中切出宽阔可见的光束。画面大部分仍为炭色、深橄榄或低饱和黑，冷白光束成为几何平面，并在反光的下方表面落成长条。细小暖光点在远背景分散，提供尺度和纵深，却不与主光争夺注意。近物呈深色剪影，偶有轮廓亮边；远物融入空气柔化之中。强烈定向阴影与地面倒影都与可见光源一致。高处的结构或空间重复向昏暗消失区后退，细节却保持选择性。构图宽敞、戏剧化且受控，发亮的空气像被照到的实体表面一样成为材料。
theme_en: A bright studio lamp sends visible beams across a dim grand hall
theme_zh: 一盏明亮影棚灯将可见光束投过昏暗的大堂
name: Cinematic lighting
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
